name: Google Search Console
purpose: Authoritative search performance metrics (clicks, impressions, CTR, average position), index coverage, sitemap status, and security issues directly from Google.
inputs_required: Verified domain or URL prefix property in Google Search Console
OAuth 2.0 or service account with Search Console API access (or manual export)
outputs: Search analytics queries and pages (clicks, impressions, CTR, position)
Crawl and indexation status
Submitted sitemap processing status
known_limits: 16-month historical data retention; 1,000-row export limit in standard web UI (up to 25,000 via API or full export to BigQuery); 2-3 day reporting lag for fresh data.
how_to_verify_output: Cross-reference total clicks/impressions in API or exported CSV against the web UI Performance report for the identical date range and country filter.

name: Bing Webmaster Tools
purpose: Search query and indexing performance on Bing/Yahoo/DuckDuckGo ecosystem, URL submission via IndexNow, and built-in SEO scan reports.
inputs_required: Verified site in Bing Webmaster Tools
API key or OAuth token (or CSV export)
outputs: Organic search queries, impressions, and clicks on Bing
Index status and crawl issues
IndexNow submission logs
Inbound link report
known_limits: Lower search volume than Google; 6-month historical retention in standard UI; IndexNow submissions require host ownership verification.
how_to_verify_output: Compare API query data against Bing Webmaster Tools Search Performance dashboard; test URL submission responses using HTTP status 200/202.

name: Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
purpose: Session-level traffic attribution, organic landing page performance, user engagement time, conversion funnel tracking, and drop-off analysis.
inputs_required: Active GA4 Property ID
NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID configured in site environment
Google Analytics Data API credentials or Explore CSV export
outputs: Organic search sessions by landing page
Key events / conversions by channel
User engagement time and bounce rate equivalent
Device and geo distribution
known_limits: 24-48 hour data processing latency for standard reports; thresholding applied when Google Signals is enabled; sampling on complex exploration reports.
how_to_verify_output: Verify real-time tag firing using Google Tag Assistant in browser; compare API output against standard Traffic Acquisition report.

name: Screaming Frog SEO Spider
purpose: Full-site desktop crawler discovering broken links (404), redirect chains (301/302), missing/duplicate meta tags, canonical inconsistencies, orphan pages, and DOM rendering issues.
inputs_required: Desktop client installation (Windows/macOS/Linux)
Target root URL or XML sitemap URL
User export of Internal_All.csv or Page_Overview.xlsx
outputs: Complete URL inventory with HTTP status codes
Title tags, meta descriptions, H1/H2 tags and lengths
Canonical tag alignment and directives (noindex/nofollow)
Inlink/outlink counts and crawl depth
known_limits: Free tier capped at 500 URLs; runs locally on user's machine (not native cloud/MCP); JavaScript rendering requires desktop Chromium execution and adequate RAM.
how_to_verify_output: Verify crawl summary statistics match total expected pages from sitemap.xml; check status codes using curl -I or browser devtools on sample URLs.

name: Google PageSpeed Insights
purpose: Simulated laboratory audits (Lighthouse) combined with real-world field data (Chrome User Experience Report - CrUX) assessing Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS).
inputs_required: Public URL accessible over internet
Optional PAGESPEED_API_KEY environment variable for higher quota (unauthenticated queries supported)
outputs: Core Web Vitals field assessments (LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, TTFB)
Lighthouse diagnostic performance score (0-100)
Render-blocking resource list and Next.js optimization opportunities
known_limits: Requires public URL (cannot test local dev servers or staging behind auth without tunneling); field data requires minimum 28-day Chrome user visit threshold.
how_to_verify_output: Run the web UI at pagespeed.web.dev for the target URL and verify laboratory and field metrics match API JSON output.

name: Google Lighthouse
purpose: Automated developer-driven audit for performance, accessibility, SEO best practices, and Progressive Web App compliance runnable locally on staging/dev servers.
inputs_required: Chrome/Chromium browser DevTools or Lighthouse CLI
Target localhost or staging URL
outputs: SEO hygiene score (meta tags, mobile friendliness, tap targets, HTTP status)
Accessibility WCAG score and failing node selectors
Lab performance waterfall and Core Web Vitals diagnostic
known_limits: Synthetic lab environment only (no real user metrics); scores vary based on host machine CPU/memory and active network throttling settings.
how_to_verify_output: Open Chrome DevTools > Lighthouse tab in an Incognito window, run Mobile/Desktop audit, and export HTML/JSON report.

name: Chrome User Experience Report (CrUX)
purpose: Official dataset of real-world user experience metrics across millions of origins, powering Google's search ranking Core Web Vitals signals.
inputs_required: Target origin or URL
Google Cloud API key with CrUX API enabled (or BigQuery access)
outputs: 75th percentile distributions for LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, FID, TTFB
28-day rolling window real-user assessment
Form factor segmentation (phone, tablet, desktop)
known_limits: Origins or specific URLs must meet minimum user traffic density thresholds; low-traffic or newly launched sites will return 'data unavailable'.
how_to_verify_output: Query CrUX API using curl with API key and verify metrics align with PageSpeed Insights 'Discover what your real users are experiencing' section.

name: Google Rich Results Test
purpose: Validates whether JSON-LD structured data on a page is syntactically valid and eligible to generate Google rich snippets in search results.
inputs_required: Public URL or raw JSON-LD code snippet
Google Search Console API key for testing API (or web interface at search.google.com/test/rich-results)
outputs: Detected rich snippet items (Organization, Article, FAQPage, LocalBusiness, BreadcrumbList)
Validation errors, warnings, and missing required properties
Rendered HTML snapshot seen by Googlebot
known_limits: Validates only Google-supported rich result types (does not validate full Schema.org taxonomy); rate limited on web interface.
how_to_verify_output: Paste rendered page source or URL into search.google.com/test/rich-results and verify detected schemas match application JsonLd.js output.

name: Schema Markup Validator
purpose: Official Schema.org structural validator testing complete schema syntax, vocabulary, entity nesting, and RDFa/Microdata/JSON-LD standards beyond Google's subset.
inputs_required: Public URL or raw HTML/JSON-LD code snippet
outputs: Complete Schema.org entity tree
Syntax warnings and vocabulary compliance errors
Property type and hierarchy validation
known_limits: Web interface only (no official open REST API); validates vocabulary compliance but does not guarantee Google rich snippet eligibility.
how_to_verify_output: Load validator.schema.org, enter the production URL, and assert zero critical syntax errors in JSON-LD blocks.

name: Semrush
purpose: Competitive keyword research, organic search volume estimates, search intent breakdown, keyword difficulty (KD%), and backlink profile auditing.
inputs_required: Target domain, competitor domain, or seed keyword list
User-exported CSV/XLSX from Organic Research or Keyword Magic Tool
outputs: Keyword list with search volume, KD%, CPC, and SERP features
Competitor organic ranking matrix
Referring domains, authority score, and anchor text distribution
known_limits: Requires active commercial subscription; data reflects search model estimates rather than 100% first-party click truth; API requires separate business tier units.
how_to_verify_output: Check exported file metadata headers and ensure sample high-ranking keywords align with live search engine results.

name: Ahrefs
purpose: Comprehensive backlink analysis, referring domain authority, anchor text audits, organic traffic estimates, and competitor content gap analysis.
inputs_required: Target domain or URL
User-exported CSV from Site Explorer (Backlinks, Referring Domains, or Organic Keywords)
outputs: Domain Rating (DR) and URL Rating (UR)
Backlink profile with dofollow/nofollow attributes
Lost and broken backlinks (404 link equity recovery)
Organic keyword rankings
known_limits: Strict credit-based usage and commercial subscription required; export limits bound by account tier; search volume is modeled third-party data.
how_to_verify_output: Verify sample referring domain URLs by checking if backlink exists in HTML with expected rel attributes.

name: Ubersuggest
purpose: Accessible keyword discovery, search volume trends, basic backlink overviews, and competitive content recommendations for small-to-medium sites.
inputs_required: Target domain or seed keyword
Exported CSV from Ubersuggest dashboard
outputs: Monthly search volume, SEO difficulty, and paid difficulty
Top SEO pages by estimated monthly traffic
Basic backlink counts
known_limits: Free tier strictly limits searches per day (3 queries); smaller index than Semrush or Ahrefs; updates less frequently on niche domains.
how_to_verify_output: Compare exported search volume trends against Google Keyword Planner directional data.

name: Google Keyword Planner
purpose: Direct search volume query ranges and commercial intent bidding data sourced directly from Google Ads infrastructure.
inputs_required: Google Ads account (active ad spend required for exact monthly volume figures, otherwise returns broad ranges e.g. 1K-10K)
Exported CSV/TSV plan
outputs: Average monthly searches
3-month and YoY change percentage
Competition level (low/medium/high)
Top of page bid ranges
known_limits: Accounts with zero ad spend show wide volume ranges (e.g. 100-1K); groups synonymous keywords together; commercial intent focused.
how_to_verify_output: Ensure currency, language, and location targeting match the project brief recorded in client-answers.md.

name: Google Search Console URL Inspection
purpose: Inspects Google's indexed version of a specific URL, checking crawl date, canonical selected by Google vs user, crawl allowed status, and indexing eligibility.
inputs_required: Verified Google Search Console property
Target URL within verified property
Google Search Console API token or manual inspection in UI
outputs: Verdict (PASS / FAIL / NEUTRAL)
Coverage state (Submitted and indexed, Crawled currently not indexed, etc.)
Google-selected canonical vs user-declared canonical
Robots.txt and indexing state
known_limits: API quota limit of 2,000 queries per day per property (and 600 per minute); inspects only URLs within verified properties owned by the user.
how_to_verify_output: Compare API response against live 'URL is on Google' result in GSC search console UI.

name: Robots.txt & Sitemap Checker
purpose: Verifies robots.txt syntax, crawl delay / disallow directives against user-agents, XML sitemap protocol validity, and presence of all canonical routes.
inputs_required: Target site base URL or direct path to robots.txt / sitemap.xml
Local companion script scripts/seo/sitemap-robots-parser.js or HTTP fetch
outputs: Directives breakdown by user-agent (*, Googlebot, Bingbot)
Disallowed paths and allowed overrides
Sitemap URL count, format validation, and lastmod timestamps
known_limits: Validates static syntax and rules; cannot guarantee third-party bot compliance (e.g. rogue bots ignoring robots.txt).
how_to_verify_output: Fetch production URL /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml using curl -IL and verify HTTP status 200 and Content-Type (text/plain and application/xml).

name: View-Source vs Rendered HTML Comparison
purpose: Compares raw server-delivered HTML (view-source / Next.js SSR) against client-hydrated rendered DOM (post-JavaScript) to ensure search bots without JS can access all critical content and metadata.
inputs_required: Target page URL
Browser curl/view-source response and DevTools Elements DOM snapshot (or Playwright script)
outputs: HTML diff of text content, links, and meta tags
Identification of client-only rendered content ('use client' hydration dependencies)
Validation of server-rendered metadata tags and canonical URLs
known_limits: Requires manual comparison or headless browser runner; dynamic user interaction states (tabs, accordions) may show expected DOM differences.
how_to_verify_output: Disable JavaScript in Chrome DevTools > Settings > Debugger > Disable JavaScript, reload page, and confirm all headings, body copy, and navigation remain visible.

name: ChatGPT Search (SearchGPT) Visibility Check
purpose: Evaluates domain visibility, source citation frequency, and snippet accuracy within OpenAI's ChatGPT Search engine.
inputs_required: Target brand name, service queries, and primary target keywords
ChatGPT web interface with search capability enabled
outputs: Citation presence and position in web sources
Accuracy of AI answer grounding for brand propositions
Detected OAI-SearchBot crawl accessibility in robots.txt
known_limits: Responses are non-deterministic; citation algorithms change continuously; cannot be queried via standard search engine APIs without commercial licensing.
how_to_verify_output: Run exact commercial and informational user queries in ChatGPT with web search toggled on; record cited URLs and anchor texts.

name: Perplexity AI Search Visibility Check
purpose: Checks answer engine retrieval and numbered citation inclusion for brand services, comparing citations against organic competitors.
inputs_required: Target domain and primary commercial service queries
Perplexity search interface or Perplexity API
outputs: Footnote citation status (cited vs omitted)
Extracted knowledge snippet summary
PerplexityBot crawl access verification
known_limits: Results vary depending on Pro model selection (Default, Claude 3.5, Sonar); citation indexes update frequently.
how_to_verify_output: Perform query on perplexity.ai, inspect 'Sources' tray at the top of the answer, and verify if target domain is listed as an active source.

name: Google AI Overviews Visibility Check
purpose: Audits whether the domain appears in Google's generative AI Overviews for informational and transactional search queries.
inputs_required: Primary search queries from seo-strategy.md
Google Search in an unpersonalized/incognito browser session in target geo market
outputs: AI Overview trigger presence (yes/no)
Domain carousel link placement and citation snippet
Content alignment with generative summary concepts
known_limits: AI Overviews vary by geography, logged-in status, and device; not all query types trigger AI Overviews (e.g. sensitive queries or simple navigations).
how_to_verify_output: Search queries in Google Chrome Incognito with location set to target client market; capture screenshot and carousel URL links.
